summary: Implemented the window title feature in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title) with a docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal is true, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR #2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified by running: tests, Black, and mypy.
